assumptions.choice: Reverse position on opposing MACD histogram threshold signal by submitting a combined order to close the open position and enter a new opposing position
assumptions.reason: An opposing threshold signal functions simultaneously as an exit signal for the current direction and an entry signal for the opposite direction, while respecting the single position constraint.

assumptions.choice: Submit a native bt.Order.Stop upon entry fill calculated from order.executed.price and ATR(14) at the fill bar
assumptions.reason: The specification calls for a fixed protective stop set on entry at entry_price +/- 2*ATR.
The specification explicitly suggests 100 shares as the fixed trade stake example.
